speaker: Doctor
text: I have noted your symptoms of fatigue, flank pain, and fever following recent antibiotic treatment for sinusitis. To determine if this is a complication like pyelonephritis or an allergic reaction, did you experience any burning sensation during urination or notice changes in your urine color? Also, did you complete the full course of antibiotics prescribed for your sinusitis?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Doctor
text: Please tell me if your urine looks cloudy, has a strong odor, or contains visible blood, as this would strongly suggest a urinary tract infection. REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis with microscopy and urine culture.

Microscopic examination (Cytospin Stained With Hansel's Solution) revealed 3% binucleated cells with eosinophilic, granular cytoplasm.
